# proxmox_sdn_controllers (Data Source)

Lists staged SDN controllers from `/cluster/sdn/controllers`, sorted by `controller`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_sdn_controllers" "evpn" {
  type = "evpn"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `type` (String) Restrict the result to one controller type. An empty value disables this filter.

### Read-Only

- `controllers` (Attributes List) Matching controllers, sorted by `controller`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--controllers))
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for this data source call.

<a id="nestedatt--controllers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `controllers`

Read-Only:

- `asn` (Number)
- `controller` (String)
- `node` (String)
- `pending` (Map of String)
- `state` (String)
- `type` (String)
